g1.label: 1. Economic factors include?
g1.why: The text says Economic factors are interest rates, exchange rates, and GDP growth.

g2.label: 2. Covers sustainability concerns?
g2.why: The text says Environmental factors are sustainability concerns.

g3.label: 3. What does 'T' represent?
g3.why: The text says Technological factors include innovation and digital trends.

g1.label: 1. Rising eco-friendly product preference
g1.why: A shift in consumer attitudes and preferences is classified as a Social factor in PESTEL, even when the preference is for eco-friendly products.

g2.label: 2. New trade tariffs
g2.why: The text says Political factors include government regulations and trade policies.

g3.label: 3. Investment in AI and automation
g3.why: The text says Technological factors include innovation and digital trends.

g4.label: 4. Minimum wage legislation
g4.why: The text says Legal factors cover labor laws and compliance requirements.
